items.source: Note: This attribute is not required to be supported by all View implementations.
items.translation: 注意：并非所有视图实现都必须支持此属性。

items.source: This class and the MVC approach associated with it is discussed in Chapter 12 of Expert One-On-One J2EE Design and Development by Rod Johnson (Wrox, 2002).
items.translation: 该类及其相关的 MVC 方法在 Rod Johnson 所著的《Expert One-On-One J2EE Design and Development》（Wrox，2002）第 12 章中进行了讨论。 Expert One-On-One J2EE Design and Development

items.source:
View implementations may differ widely. An obvious implementation would be
JSP-based. Other implementations might be XSLT-based, or use an HTML generation library.
This interface is designed to avoid restricting the range of possible implementations.
items.translation: 实现方式可能差异很大。一种显而易见的实现是基于 JSP 的。其他实现可能是基于 XSLT 的，或者使用 HTML 生成库。此接口旨在避免限制可能的实现范围。

items.source:
Views should be beans. They are likely to be instantiated as beans by a ViewResolver.
As this interface is stateless, view implementations should be thread-safe.
items.translation: 视图应该是 Bean。它们很可能会由 ViewResolver 作为 Bean 进行实例化。由于此接口是无状态的，视图实现应该是线程安全的。

items.source:
Can be used to check the view's content type upfront,
i.e. before an actual rendering attempt.
items.translation: 可用于提前检查视图的内容类型，即在实际渲染尝试之前。

items.source:
The first step will be preparing the request: In the JSP case, this would mean
setting model objects as request attributes. The second step will be the actual
rendering of the view, for example including the JSP via a RequestDispatcher.
items.translation: 第一步是准备请求：在 JSP 的情况下，这意味着将模型对象设置为请求属性。第二步是实际渲染视图，例如通过 RequestDispatcher 包含 JSP。

items.source: The MediaType selected during content negotiation, which may be more specific than the one the View is configured with.
items.translation: 内容协商期间选择的MediaType，其具体程度可能高于视图所配置的媒体类型。

items.source: The MediaType selected during content negotiation, which may be more specific than the one the View is configured with. For example: "application/vnd.example-v1+xml" vs "application/*+xml".
items.translation: 内容协商期间选择的 MediaType 可能与视图配置的媒体类型更具体。例如："application/vnd.example-v1+xml" 与 "application/*+xml"。

items.source: the content type String (optionally including a character set), or null if not predetermined
items.translation: 内容类型为 String（可选地包含字符集），或者如果未预先确定则为null。

items.source: response - he HTTP response we are building
items.translation: response - 我们正在构建的 HTTP 响应

items.source: Rod Johnson, Arjen Poutsma, Rossen Stoyanchev
Name of the HttpServletRequest attribute that contains a Map with path variables.
items.translation: 包含路径变量的 Map 的 HttpServletRequest 属性名称。

items.source: Name of the HttpServletRequest attribute that contains the response status code.
items.translation: 包含响应状态代码的 HttpServletRequest 属性名称。

items.source: Return the content type of the view, if predetermined.
items.translation: 如果已预先确定，则返回视图的内容类型。

items.source: Render the view given the specified model.
items.translation: 根据指定的模型渲染视图。

items.source: model - a Map with name Strings as keys and corresponding model objects as values (Map can also be null in case of empty model)
items.translation: model - 一个以名称字符串为键、对应模型对象为值的 Map（若模型为空，该 Map 也可以为 null）

items.source: Exception - if rendering failed
items.translation: Exception - 如果渲染失败
